# rustinion_on_call_schedule (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion on-call schedule: a rotation of users an escalation policy can optionally name in its notifications (purely for message enrichment — escalation timing never depends on it). See on_call.rs in the main repo for the rotation math: who's on call is a deterministic, stateless function of (now - started_at) / rotation_days over the member list below, in order. Time-bounded overrides (a real vacation/swap) are a separate resource, rustinion_on_call_override, not a block here.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group this on-call schedule belongs to.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `member` (Block List) One rotation member, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--member))
- `rotation_days` (Number) Rotation length in days — 7 for a weekly rotation. Defaults to 7.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned on-call schedule ID.
- `started_at` (String) When this schedule's rotation clock started (RFC3339), server-assigned at creation and never changes afterward.

### Nested Schema for `member`

Required:

- `user_id` (String)
